plugins.faceIDPermission: MyStudyFlow keeps your sign-in in the device keychain so you do not have to type it each time. Face ID is only ever used by iOS to unlock that stored sign-in on this device — MyStudyFlow never receives or stores biometric data, and no other feature uses it.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: MyStudyFlow uses your approximate location to show current weather on your home screen. For example, showing the temperature and a rain icon for where you are beside today's classes, so you know what to expect walking between them. The app works normally if you decline.
plugins.motionUsagePermission: MyStudyFlow's weather widget asks iOS for your approximate location, and the location service may use motion data to work that out — for example, to settle on a position without waking the GPS. MyStudyFlow does not read step counts, workouts or any activity history.

plugins.cameraPermission: MyStudyFlow uses the camera so you can photograph your own study notes and keep them with a study session. For example, after working through a page of maths problems you can take a picture of it and it is saved against that session, so you can look back at what you actually did.
plugins.photosPermission: MyStudyFlow uses your photo library so you can attach pictures you have already taken to a study session. For example, choosing an existing photo of your worked solutions to keep alongside the time you logged for that subject.
